_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: My pookie. I want to start by saying how much I appreciate you. Since meeting me, you've witnessed me at the absolute worst moments of my life so far. And even through all of that, I never felt for even a moment that you loved me any less. You supported me in a time that I couldn't have possibly made it through without you. You motivated me to keep going even though I wanted to just sit there and rot. You've constantly pushed me and supported me to get better, physically, mentally, financially, morally. You've made me a better man every single day. I learn so much from you, even when you don’t intend on teaching me something. The way you live your life, the way you navigate the challenges in life, inspires me more than you can ever imagine. You are so unbelievably smart and wise. You made me realize things about myself I don’t think I ever would have changed if it wasn’t for you. I owe so much to you. I hope that throughout this long journey of life, I am able to love you and support you and help you in every possible way I can. I hope to love you endlessly and continue to make everlasting memories with you that we will hold on to until our final breaths. I long for a time when we’re both old and frail and still sitting side by side on the couch eating a good meal and watching our favorite shows together. With an amazing family that also has their own amazing family. We will look back at all these moments that we had together, and we can be proud of every little step we took to make that a reality, and all of the small moments that we shared together along the way. I love you more than anything, and I will always love you with every single ounce of myself.
